faqs.q: What kind of news updates are available?
faqs.a: The page lists various news articles covering topics such as digital birth certificates, cost-of-living relief, and changes to service centres.

faqs.q: When was the last update about digital birth certificates?
faqs.a: Secure Digital Birth Certificates were announced as available on March 17, 2026, and also on November 26, 2025.

faqs.q: What recent changes were made to driving licences?
faqs.a: The NSW Government reformed overseas driving licence arrangements on February 1, 2026, to keep NSW roads safe.
